title: precheck's after-merge warning fires on any check text that names _querylog, such as bench_querylog.py or a throwaway store
goal: bl_precheck.DELIVERY_READ matches a read of the committed query-log store or of backlog.py cost figures only, not the substring _querylog anywhere, so precheck's after-merge warning stays quiet on a check that only builds a throwaway query-log store or runs bench_querylog.py or a test_querylog*.py selection. Found by the SP-sqgyoiaz review (S3), the warning also fired on ST-pwosmcdj's own check.

run: import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_precheck as b;sys.exit(1 if b.DELIVERY_READ.search('python3 _tools/bench_querylog.py --dry-run') else 0)
import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_precheck as b;sys.exit(1 if b.DELIVERY_READ.search('python3 _tools/bench_querylog.py --dry-run') else 0)
